request.state:
Icelandic original: „Matarkistan á Suðurlandi, hægt að kaupa afurðir beint frá bændum, mikið menningarlíf. Stutt í hálendið þar sem er friðsæld og víðátta.“
English gloss: “Foodland in Southland, possible to buy products directly from farmers, great cultural life. Short to the highlands where it is peaceful and wide-ranging.”

faithful.instructions: Is the English gloss a faithful translation of the Icelandic original, with no added or missing meaning?
